assertion_audit.fails_if: Review waiting is bypassed or reported refused.
Dispatch is omitted, repeated or targets the original head rather than the git-observed repair.
Pending record retains the original head rather than the git-observed repair.
Primary HEAD advances before review storage.
Repair content reaches the primary checkout before storage.
An unconditional review hold prevents stored matching review from releasing the repair.
The second pass dispatches again instead of reading storage.
Finishing invokes promotion again, changing the previously observed call log.
Finishing leaves the live pointer present.
Finishing leaves the pending record present.

assertion_independence: No added assertion merely round-trips review inputs: the expected head comes from git commit output; dispatch, pending storage, primary HEAD, content, promotion calls and retirement are separate observations. Existing remote-head equality and repaired-content assertions remain.
evidence_caveats: Unmodified base fails with no live run; awaiting-review is reproduced by the documented fixture adjustment at unchanged historical product revisions.
The process-launch boundary is stubbed; actual worker execution is outside the test.
Worker normalized scheduler-notice placement and retained raw .asreceived captures.

findings.text: non-blocking: compose duplicates the eight-line review-dispatch recorder in tests/test_a_repaired_head_is_reviewed_and_landed.py:131 verbatim; it neither extends nor wraps that helper, leaving two fixture implementations of the same dispatch return shape to maintain.
